attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Marshall, Harold H. Greene and Isabel L. Blair for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied without prejudice to another application under 28 U. S. C. § 2255 to the appropriate District Court, which application should be considered on its merits and not as a successive application.
